e95191016fd94413.desc: Check out the newest exhibit at the Camarillo Ranch:  Isabel Camarillo . Dive into the world of the matriarch of the Camarillo Family and learn more about this historic figure in her actual home. Docent led house tours are on Saturdays and Sundays from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM (last tour starts at 1:30 PM). House tour fees are $5.00 per person (cash only). Children 12 and under are free. Rubber soled shoes are recommended. If there is a special event on either day, tours may not occur. Please review  dates we are closed  due to events, etc. Looking to become more involved at the Camarillo Ranch? Board of Directors seats are now open. If you would like to join the Camarillo Ranch Foundation’s Board of Directors, please complete the application provided here.  Email the completed application to info@camarilloranch.org.

e9e1313eb8d741fe.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
e9e1313eb8d741fe.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life. This year’s goal is to raise $15,000, and we can accomplish it with…
